_readme: Anglická verze webu (/en/). Build (build/build.mjs, renderHome) vezme českou šablonu build/templates/index.template.html a nahradí v ní každý klíč z 'homepage' anglickým textem. Když se český text v šabloně změní, klíč přestane sedět a build SPADNE s názvem chybějícího textu: pak uprav klíč i překlad tady. Zbylá čeština v anglické stránce build také zastaví (výjimky = vlastní jména v '_allow'). Reference a case studies ze Sheetu se překládají podle id (references/cases); co tu chybí, na anglické stránce není. Pravidla obsahu platí i v angličtině: bez dlouhé pomlčky, bez vymyšlených čísel. Čtenář = klient (HR a management zahraničních firem), často ne rodilý mluvčí: krátké věty, bez idiomů, britský pravopis.

homepage.<p class=\"hero-sub rv-load\" style=\"--: We search the Czech labour market for people who have a job and are not applying, from CNC setters and programmers to production directors. Within 10 days we present the first candidates, matched to a brief we agree on together.
homepage.Pošlete nám pozici, která vám nedá spát<: Send us the role that keeps you up at night<span
homepage.<p class=\"proof-intro rv\">Klienti nás: Clients do not value us for the number of CVs. They value accurate profiles, candidate notes they can use and a clear view of what is really happening in the market.
homepage.<blockquote class=\"proof-quote\">„Ani j: “Not a single candidate was completely off target.”
homepage.<blockquote class=\"proof-quote\">„Pozná: “We later used the notes on the candidates in our interviews.”
homepage.<blockquote class=\"proof-quote\">„Uchaz: “Candidates we thought did not exist on the market at all.”
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\">Když inzerce nesta: When job ads are not working, another ad will not help.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\">Většina klientů se: Most clients contact us after they have tried the usual channels and seen the active candidates. At that point, we do not post another ad. The people you need usually have a job, do not apply and do not appear through the usual channels. But they are willing to talk about the right offer.
homepage.<p class=\"rv\">Nejtěžší nebývá najít ře: The hardest person to find is rarely the director. Directors tend to be visible. The hardest is the specialist who has a job, is not looking and would probably ignore a standard offer. That is why they never answer a job ad.
homepage.<div class=\"kicker rv\">Jiný druh práce: A different kind of work
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\">Běžná agentura pra: A typical agency works with whoever applies. We work with the people who never would.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\" style=\"margin-top:: The active part of the market is made up of people who are looking right now, answering ads or open to offers. We also work with people who have a job, do not apply and never appear through the usual channels. They have a strong profile not because they want a new job, but because they are good at the one they have. We approach them directly.
homepage.<blockquote>„Konzultanti dokázali přesně: “The consultants identified exactly which companies were likely to employ a suitable candidate for the role.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Služby Sintery využíváme pr: “We use Sintera for its deep knowledge of the labour market and its wide reach across disciplines and positions.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Ve velmi krátkém časovém ho: “In a very short time, we filled a position we had been trying to fill for a long while.”
homepage.<blockquote>„I přes velmi specifickou po: “Even though the position was very specific, the vast majority of candidates met the minimum requirements we set in the brief.”
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\">Když roli špatně p: Describe the role the wrong way and the right people slip through the net.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\" style=\"margin-top:: The market may use a different name for the role than the one you have in mind. One badly worded requirement is enough to lose a candidate who can do four of the five things you need. Not because they are unsuitable, but because the brief was aimed in the wrong place.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\">Proto nejdřív zpřes: So we start by clarifying who you really need: what the person must be able to do, what experience they must have, what environment they will work in and how you will know they are succeeding.
homepage.<blockquote>„Stačil krátký hovor, aby by: “A short call was enough to describe the position properly. Sintera understands the personality profile the candidate needs.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Jasně strukturovaný přístup: “A clearly structured approach reduced the delays caused by an unclear or misunderstood brief.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Profily kandidátů s velkou: “The candidate profiles matched the positions we were looking to fill with great accuracy.”
homepage.<blockquote>„Kandidáti doporučení k poho: “The candidates recommended for interview matched our requirements in experience, knowledge and expectations for the role.”
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\" style=\"max-width:: Tools open doors. Experience decides which ones to knock on.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\">Máme vlastní search: We have our own search infrastructure: tools we largely build ourselves, our own methods and know-how developed over years. It is not rocket science. But not everyone can build it and use it well, day after day. Just as you have a production line for your product, we have a production line for finding your person.
homepage.<div class=\"lbl\">Mapování trhu</div><d:
Market mapping
Who can actually do the job, including people outside job boards and databases.
homepage.<div class=\"lbl\">Přímé oslovení</div><:
Direct approach
Specific people, contacted directly, with an offer that fits them.
homepage.<div class=\"lbl\">Posouzení a kontext</:
Assessment and context
The background that explains why a candidate is worth talking to.
homepage.<div class=\"lbl\">Představení</div><div:
Shortlist
Only candidates who are worth talking to.
It is not about the number of CVs. It is about how many are worth an interview.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\" style=\"margin-top:: We do not send dozens of profiles and leave you to guess why they arrived. We present each candidate with context: why they match the brief, what is worth checking and why the conversation is worth having.
homepage.<h2 class=\"rv\">Když běžné cesty nestač: When the usual channels were not enough
homepage.<span>Konkrétní situace, role a výsledky: Specific situations, roles and results. Ask us and we will send you a wider selection. The client quotes on this page are translated from Czech.
homepage.<h2 class=\"lead rv\">Search nevede form: A search is not run by a form. It is run by a person who knows the market.
homepage.<p class=\"body rv\">Za search odpovídá: Every search is led by a person who knows why they are sending you a candidate. You are not waiting on an anonymous process. For each assignment, you know who is running it, why the search is going in this direction and what is happening in the market.
homepage.<h2 class=\"rv\">Aktuálně hledáme</h2>: What we are working on now
homepage.<p class=\"positions-lead rv\">Výběr rol: Our job ads are published in Czech, because the people we approach work in the Czech Republic. They show the range of roles we fill: machine setters, CNC programmers, maintenance technicians, quality and design engineers, buyers and production managers. We do not publish every search.

rotor.rot_01: We present candidates with a clear reason to talk to them. Not profiles that leave you guessing why they were sent.
rotor.rot_02: When a search is precise, the company does not sort through a pile of irrelevant CVs. It talks to people who make sense.
rotor.rot_03: Sometimes the goal is not more applications. It is finding people who never appear, because they already have a job.
rotor.rot_04: A candidate should not be just somewhere near the brief. There should be a clear reason why they are worth an interview.
rotor.rot_05: A good search delivers more than CVs. It delivers context that helps the company decide faster and on the facts.

ref_zf_passive_safety.quote: 99% of the candidates presented go straight to interview.
ref_zf_passive_safety.long: For quality roles in automotive, the cooperation is set up so that the candidates who reach the shortlist match the requirements. There is no sorting through irrelevant CVs, and 99% of the candidates presented go straight to interview. Most of the positions are filled through Sintera.

ref_sitel.role: Data centre technician, field response technician, site manager
ref_sitel.quote: We also received candidates who had seemed unreachable on the market.
ref_sitel.long: The written candidate presentations are thorough, clear and accurate. The candidates match the company's specific needs, expertise and budget. Within a short time, Sintera also reached people who had seemed unreachable on the market.

ref_alstom.quote: Not a single candidate presented was outside the scope of the role.
ref_alstom.long: Sintera delivers precisely targeted candidates to the procurement department. None of them fall outside the scope of the role. The candidate notes include detailed comments on each profile, and the communication helps define the expectations for the position more precisely.

ref_windmoller_holscher.quote: The candidate notes include Sintera's comments and the candidate's salary expectations.
ref_windmoller_holscher.long: Communication throughout the cooperation is efficient and useful. The candidate notes include Sintera's comments, relevant information about the position and the person, and their salary expectations. So the company gets more than a CV: it gets the context for a decision.

ref_jtekt_czech_republic.quote: Several candidates often move on to the next rounds.
ref_jtekt_czech_republic.long: The candidate profiles have a clear structure, are easy to read and contain what matters for the decision. The candidates match the requirements of the position, and several of them often move on to the next rounds.

ref_nestle_cesko.role: Product and process specialist, safety technician
ref_nestle_cesko.quote: The profiles matched the agreed brief very closely.
ref_nestle_cesko.long: The profiles match the agreed brief very closely. Fast communication with the candidates keeps the selection moving without unnecessary delays. After a few interviews, the company selected a candidate for the product and process role.

ref_aisan_industry.quote: The selection process ended sooner than expected.
ref_aisan_industry.long: The team works professionally and in a clearly structured way, which reduces the delays caused by an unclear brief. Even for a very specific position, most candidates met the requirements, and the selection process ended sooner than expected.

ref_siemens_energy.quote: The notes on the candidates were used directly in the interviews.
ref_siemens_energy.long: Communication is fast and pleasant. The notes attached to the CVs are detailed enough to be used directly in the interviews. Of four candidates, two moved on to the second round and both reached the offer stage.

ref_trw_carr.quote: The consultants ask about the real content of the role in detail.
ref_trw_carr.long: The consultants go to the core of the position. They ask what the person will do, which team they will join and how the brief changes during the search. As a result, the search is based on the real context of the work, not just on the job title.

ref_zf_electronics_klasterec.role: SMT, engineering, HR and technical positions
ref_zf_electronics_klasterec.quote: A stable team of consultants keeps its knowledge of the company and the industry.
ref_zf_electronics_klasterec.long: Sintera keeps a stable team of consultants who know the company and the automotive environment. Candidates go through thorough screening, and the profiles highlight the key professional skills expected for the position.

ref_r_s_automotive.quote: Each candidate summary contains everything needed for the decision.
ref_r_s_automotive.long: Long-term cooperation means Sintera knows the company well and chooses suitable candidates. The summary for each person contains everything needed for the decision and works as a practical basis for the selection.

ref_sanborn.quote: The notes summarise the candidate's motivation, availability and salary expectations.
ref_sanborn.long: Sintera helps fill even hard-to-fill positions in a short time. The CVs match the brief, and the introductory note summarises what matters for the decision: motivation to change jobs, availability for interview and salary expectations.

ref_spofadental.quote: A weekly report gives an ongoing view of the search.
ref_spofadental.long: A weekly activity report gives an ongoing view of what is happening in the search. The cooperation is based on a regular supply of profiles and candidate notes that need no corrections.

ref_m_a_s_automation.quote: The profile of the position was understood precisely.
ref_m_a_s_automation.long: The profile of the position was understood precisely. The research of potential candidates is professional and fast. The quality of candidates is above average against the benchmark, and the positions were filled in a short time.

ref_konplan.role: Software developer, design engineer, PLC programmer, project manager
ref_konplan.quote: Even the candidates recommended for interview praise how Sintera deals with them.
ref_konplan.long: Sintera's professionalism is also confirmed by feedback from the candidates themselves after their interviews. The candidate assessments and the notes on the CVs speed up the process of filling the role.

ref_vitesco_technologies.quote: The selected candidate started on the agreed date.
ref_vitesco_technologies.long: Work on filling the position started immediately after the order. Communication is open and efficient. A suitable person was selected from the candidates presented, the contract was signed and the new employee started on the agreed date.

ref_linet.role: Country Manager India and strategic management roles
ref_linet.quote: The position was filled ahead of the planned date.
ref_linet.long: The consultants identified exactly which companies were likely to employ a suitable candidate. The candidates matched both the requirements and the budget. A position that had been difficult to fill in the past was filled ahead of the planned date.

ref_vyzkumny_ustav_zeleznicni.quote: The profiles match the position briefs with great accuracy.
ref_vyzkumny_ustav_zeleznicni.long: The search is efficient and precisely targeted at the positions required. Profiles arrive quickly, and the candidate notes provide key information for the interview. The cooperation has lasted many years and covers several fields and levels of seniority.

case_presnost_misto_objemu_99_kandidatu_.win: 99% of the candidates presented go on to interview, and most positions are filled through Sintera.

case_pozice_kterou_trh_dlouho_nenabidl.win: The position was filled in a very short time, and the cooperation extended to further roles.

case_dlouhodobe_partnerstvi_napric_obory.change: Sintera keeps a stable team of consultants and maintains its knowledge of the company over the long term.

case_search_rizeny_detailnim_briefem.meta: Quality engineers and technical roles · Automotive · Central Bohemia
case_search_rizeny_detailnim_briefem.name: A search driven by a detailed brief
case_search_rizeny_detailnim_briefem.situ: The profile must match the real work and the team, not just the job title.
case_search_rizeny_detailnim_briefem.why: Without a detailed understanding of the role, the search risks poor targeting and unnecessary rounds of irrelevant candidates.
case_search_rizeny_detailnim_briefem.change: The consultants ask about the content of the work, the team and any changes to the brief, and adjust the search accordingly.

organization.description: Sintera Czech is a recruitment consultancy specialising in direct search for manufacturing and engineering companies in the Czech Republic. It fills skilled trade and technical roles (CNC programmers, machine setters, milling operators, welders, fitters, toolmakers, electromechanics, maintenance technicians), technician and engineering roles (quality, design, process engineering, automation) as well as management and top management. It approaches people directly who have a job and are not actively looking.
serviceType: Recruitment for technical and manufacturing roles
knowsAbout: recruitment in manufacturing and mechanical engineering
